_doc: Inputs of bay_manifest@v1 (T-100, R-100, Q-200/Q-201/Q-202). Changing any non-underscore value changes the manifest fingerprint. `snapshots` are written by `bay_manifest.py refresh-indexes` (index/HEAD queries) and `scan-osm`; they pin the external indexes so the manifest is reproducible offline.
bay_region_note: First polygon: the Bay and Delta east of the Golden Gate mouth (Point Bonita - Lands End) and the Peninsula spine; it runs over land so only water inside it counts. Rectangles: Tomales Bay, Bolinas Lagoon, Drakes Estero, Bodega Harbor (estuaries, Q-201 'Bay/estuary water'). Approximate by design.

classes._src: Assumed thresholds (R-100 section 2): land_min_fraction ~ 4200 m2 of dry land in a 4.19 km2 tile; urban at >= 100 OSM building ways (1048 of 3049 land tiles); a water tile is Bay/estuary when >= 50 % of its water lies inside a bay_region polygon, else open ocean.

provenance.osm_scan_rule: building ways, first node location, BayTM tile (relations ignored)
